name: LiNode Light Gathering with Octree Traversal
definition: Gathers lighting information for a ray by traversing an octree of surfels, returning the closest hit color and distance.
summary: LiNode Light Gathering with Octree Traversal is a ray-surfel intersection method that traverses an octree to find the closest hit color, differing from siblings by operating on surfel primitives within octree leaves rather than triangles.
